Using AutoStacc

Buying on AutoStacc

How a purchase works from the store to Your Stacc: carts, checkout, guest purchases, creators' products and receipts.

On this page

  1. From the store to checkout
  2. With or without an account
  3. Products from creators
  4. Things the store won't do

Last updated October 16, 2026

Everything on AutoStacc is a digital download. You pay once and the files are yours to download from Your Stacc whenever you need them.

From the store to checkout

  1. Find something in the store or on a project's page and choose Add to cart. Free products have Get it free instead and go straight to Your Stacc.
  2. Open your cart. The store prices everything itself, so what you see there is what you'll pay before tax.
  3. Choose Checkout. Payment happens on Stripe's secure page; your card details never reach AutoStacc.
  4. When you come back, the confirmation page shows your order. Your files are in Your Stacc, and a receipt is on its way by email.

Some bank payments are confirmed a little later. The confirmation page keeps checking on its own, and you can check an order again from Settings › Orders.

With or without an account

You can buy without an account. Your receipt email then has a link that opens Your Stacc for that purchase; open it on the same device if you can. With an account, everything you buy stays together in one Your Stacc, on any device. See I bought without an account if you need to bring a guest purchase into an account.

Products from creators

Besides AutoStacc's own products, the store lists products made by creators in the Studio. Each one says who made it. Creators AutoStacc hasn't verified yet carry an Unverified creator label: their files are checked automatically to be what their names say, but not for quality or rights.

A cart with both AutoStacc products and creators' products is paid in two steps, one group after the other. The cart explains which is which, and the other group waits in your cart.

Things the store won't do

  • Sell you something you already own: it shows as STACC'D instead.
  • Charge you twice for one press of Checkout: pressing it again opens the same order.
  • Ask for your card number on AutoStacc itself, or on a creator's page. Payments only happen on Stripe's page.

What you may do with the files depends on the kind of product: see Licences.
